invariants.text: Product.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
A product's price must be greater than or equal to the specified minimum price when filtering by maximum price and minimum quantity.
A product's quantity must be greater than or equal to the specified minimum quantity when filtering by category, name, maximum price, and minimum quantity.
Products filtered by category must only include products that belong to the specified category.
Products filtered by name must only include products whose name matches the specified name.
Products filtered by maximum price must only include products whose price is less than or equal to the specified maximum price.
All filter conditions, including name, category, maximum price, and minimum quantity, are combinable in a single query.
